tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile teamwork. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Architetto SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Architetto SAP Commerce Cloud role at ADENTIS Italia. With over five years of professional experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in enterprise e-commerce development and platform integration.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: OCC REST APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows and headless commerce integrations.

bullets.label: Data Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), customized Backoffice components, and managed platforms through the Hybris Admin Console (HAC).

cover_en.gap: While my background is rooted in hands-on development, configuration, and integration of SAP Commerce Cloud solutions rather than high-level architecture design, I am very keen to expand my strategic platform design capabilities.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, and hold a valid residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, and I am available to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise fits your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to ADENTIS Italia. Working on complex enterprise systems for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell has prepared me to tackle challenging e-commerce requirements and deliver robust, scalable backend solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, Java, and Spring skills to deliver robust enterprise e-commerce solutions for ADENTIS Italia.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am interested in the Architetto SAP Commerce Cloud role. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Architetto SAP Commerce Cloud - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Architetto SAP Commerce Cloud position at ADENTIS Italia. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring, I bring proven skills in backend development, OCC APIs, and integrations.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026, and available to start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
